get_all_tasks_for_review: get all available tasks from the database with unit counts and review status for the review app
find_all_units_for_task: find all units associated with a given task ID using the app database connection
find_completed_units_for_task: find only completed units for a given task ID filtered by assignment completion status
check_if_task_reviewed: check if a task has been reviewed by verifying all completed units have progressed past COMPLETED status
check_task_has_stats: check if a task has stats available by inspecting its task runs and form composer tags
